names.name: Buck’S Horn
names.note: Swine-cresses; trailing, small jagged leaves, whitish clustered flowers on dry ground fit swine-cress.

cul:052-bucks-horn.text: This is also under the dominion of Saturn; the virtues are held to be the same as Buck’s-horn Plaintain, and therefore by all authors it is joined with it. The leaves bruised and applied to the place, stop bleeding. The herbs bruised and applied to warts, will make them consume and waste in a short time.
